description: Changes the signed-in member's own Vibe Coding Builders page. update_profile changes the builder profile; update_story changes the story page. Only the fields sent change. is_public true makes the page public. A page cannot be made private. Changes are live at once. Limits: 10 changes in 10 minutes, 40 a day.

profile.description: For update_profile: the builder profile fields to change. Only the fields sent change; null clears a text or link.

avatar_url.description: A full https link to a picture.

expertise.description: Things the member knows well; at least 1 when sent.

featured_project_ids.description: Up to 2 of the member's own project ids, first = pinned.

is_public.description: true makes the page public. A page cannot be made private.

newsletter_url.description: A full http(s) link, or null to clear it.

support_link.description: A full http(s) link, or null to clear it.

website_url.description: A full http(s) link, or null to clear it.

story.description: For update_story: the story page fields to change. Only the fields sent change.

headline_quote.description: A short quote of the member, shown at the top.

pinned_project_id.description: One of the member's own project ids to show first.

primary_cta_label.description: The words on the main button, for example "Read my newsletter".

pull_quote_source_url.description: A full http(s) link, or null to clear it.

story_extra.description: The whole list of extra build-log events; an empty list or null clears it.

name: manage_my_page
title: Change my VCB page
